title: Shallow Robustness, Deep Vulnerabilities: Multi-Turn Evaluation of Medical LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model robustness in a multi-turn setting by introducing follow-up prompts where an authoritative figure (e.g., a 'senior clinician' or an 'answer checker') explicitly suggests an incorrect multiple-choice answer.
Testing if models change their initial correct answers when presented with a follow-up prompt stating that 'several colleagues initially chose' an incorrect option (social proof).
Injecting misleading, RAG-style, alternative, or edge-case contextual paragraphs into multi-turn dialogues that implicitly support an incorrect diagnostic option without explicitly asserting it.

Replicating single-turn benchmarks (BiasMedQA) and applying multi-turn adaptations (e.g., 'recency-prior' mentioning a similar recent case) to trigger standard human cognitive biases such as confirmation, frequency, and status quo bias.
